description: Create a new job-history (a new All-logs/<name>/ folder + empty materialized index) and optionally set it as the active history for MCP and/or the extension. Does not copy existing logs — use the migration script for that.

set_extension_active.description: Set this as the extension's active history (default false).

set_mcp_active.description: Set this as MCP's active history (default true).

name: cpfs_create_history
